newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers 10.5 trln lire medium/long term paper.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers 10.5 trln lire medium/long term paper.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it will issue a total 10.5 trillion lire of three, five, 10 and 30-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) and seven year floating rate certificates (CCT) at its regular end-of-month auction.
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer:
* 2.0 trillion lire of a third tranche of three-year BTPs.
* 3.0 trillion lire of a first tranche of five-year BTPs.
* 1.5 trillion lire of a 17th tranche of 10-yr BTPs.
* 2.0 trillion lire of a ninth tranche of 30-yr BTPs.
* 2.0 trillion lire of a fifth tranche of seven-year CCTs.
The auctions take place on May 29 and 30.
